primary_hypothesis: Fixed premium-crop targets strand empty tiles after their latest viable planting day. Replacing only expired empty-cell targets with the harvestable wheat/carrot option having the highest observed-price terminal cash increases final bank without displacing more valuable work.
isolated_change: Do not change expansion, herd, labor, worker routing, inventory threshold, or liquidation.
For empty cells only, rotate an expired planned crop to feasible WHEAT or CARROT.
Choose by expected mature yield times current observed price minus seed cost.
Stop when neither short crop can finish before the terminal horizon.
expected_metric_movement: higher final money and margin on scenarios with late empty cells
no new invalid actions or runtime regression
no decline in low-tail money large enough to indicate task displacement
failure_modes: watering and harvest work displaces animal care or liquidation
current price is a poor estimate of realized sell price after market impact
seed and worker opportunity costs exceed the late crop revenue
the overflow-routing parent remains unnecessary noise

development_screen.kill_rule: Reject without validation if any development condition fails. Do not tune the crop choice on these seeds.

validation_rule: If development passes, register new unused validation/safety seeds and numeric gates in Git before running them.
ladder_use: No Kaggle rating or competition submission may influence development or validation. Default endpoint is private Save & Run.
